comments.body:
Thanks - I think beyond just adding source files:

- MELPA typically avoids packaging LICENSE files, but we try to be rigorous with license boilerplate (the MIT/GPL license flags are mostly clear, so that looks good, maybe one could be added to utf8proc-2.10.0/utf8proc_data.c)
- On that note, the repo itself is stuffing the fzf LICENSE into an `etc` subdirectory, which means that common tooling won't find it.  Here's an example of two licenses in a repo: https://github.com/github/docs
